take: Utah announced it has placed right wing Kailer Yamamoto on injured reserve. Our numbers rate him well: UTA controlled 71% of the 5-on-5 expected goals (the quality of chances) with him on the ice, and the team's share was about 16 points better with him than without. He has three goals and four assists in nine games. In the three games since he went out, Clayton Keller has moved onto the second line beside Hayton and Lee and is up to 20:09 a night from 18:04, while Jack McBain has gone to 13:21 from 11:07.
